{{Current events|year=2020|month=04|day=13|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]]
**[[2019–20 Western Libya offensive]]
***[[Government of National Accord|GNA]] forces recapture the city of [[Sabratha]], and the nearby town of [[Sorman]] in the [[Zawiya District]], while seizing armored vehicles and weapons belonging to the [[Libyan National Army]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/libya-govt-forces-recapture-town-city-near-tripoli/1802807 (Anadolu Agency)]
***The Libyan National Army confirms one of its [[Mil Mi-24|Mi-35]] helicopters has been shot down near [[Misrata]], killing three crew members onboard. [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/turkish-air-defense-system-shoots-down-russian-made-chopper/ (Al Masdar News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Socio-economic impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[The Walt Disney Company]] reports it is entering a [[U.S. dollar|US$]]5 billion unsecured credit agreement, possibly to make up for shortfalls in its [[Disney Parks, Experiences and Products|theme park division]].  [[Citibank|Citibank, N.A.]] is the main broker of the deal. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-disney-loan/disney-enters-5-billion-credit-agreement-idUSKCN21V26G?il=0 (Reuters)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Easter tornado outbreak]]
**The tornado outbreak continues from [[Easter|Easter Sunday]] across the [[Southeastern United States]]. At least 30 people are confirmed dead. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/04/13/tornadoes-severe-weather-south-brutal-storms-moving-into-east/2981106001/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Fiji]] declares a 30-day state of natural disaster in areas affected by [[Cyclone Harold]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/414134/fiji-declares-state-of-natural-disaster-after-cyclone-harold (RNZ)]
*[[2020 Chernobyl Exclusion Zone wildfires]]
**[[Wildfire]]s in the [[Chernobyl Exclusion Zone]], [[Ukraine]], reach the abandoned city of [[Pripyat]], {{convert|2|km|mi|abbr=on}} away from the [[Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2020/apr/13/ukraine-wildfires-close-chernobyl-nuclear-site (''The Guardian'')]

;Health and environment
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 4,342 new confirmed cases and 717 more deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], bringing the [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s death toll to 11,329 and 88,621 total cases. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-britain-toll/uk-coronavirus-death-toll-rises-to-11329-up-by-717-idUSKCN21V1BE (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Guam]]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic on USS Theodore Roosevelt|2020 coronavirus pandemic on USS ''Theodore Roosevelt'']]
*****The [[United States Navy]] confirms the first death of a sailor serving aboard the [[aircraft carrier]] [[USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71)|USS ''Theodore Roosevelt'']]. Over 500 sailors on the ship have tested positive for the virus. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52272249 (BBC)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Wyoming]]
****[[Wyoming]]'s Governor [[Mark Gordon (politician)|Mark Gordon]] reports the state's first death from COVID-19 in [[Johnson County, Wyoming|Johnson County]], meaning all 50 [[United States|U.S.]] states have now recorded a fatality from the virus. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-usa-wyoming/wyoming-reports-first-coronavirus-death-marking-loss-of-life-in-all-50-us-states-idUKKCN21V1VQ (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Joe Biden 2020 presidential campaign]]
**Less than a week after dropping out of the race, [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Bernie Sanders]] officially [[List of Joe Biden 2020 presidential campaign endorsements|endorses]] former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]], the [[presumptive nominee]] in the [[2020 United States presidential election|general election]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/04/13/us/politics/bernie-sanders-joe-biden-endorsement.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s re-election campaign files a defamation lawsuit against Wisconsin TV station [[WJFW-TV]] for airing an advertisement by [[Priorities USA Action]] which [[Criticism of response to the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic#United States government|criticizes Trump's response]] to [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.ibtimes.com/trump-reelection-campaign-files-lawsuit-against-wisconsin-tv-station-anti-trump-ad-2957829 (''International Business Times'')]
